name: audit-cloud-lab
description: Vue 3 audit management platform running on the Firebase Emulator Suite (demo project, synthetic data).

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-audit-cloud "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-audit-cloud
scripts.e2e:emu: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-audit-cloud "npm run seed && npm run e2e"
scripts.e2e:offline: VITE_BACKEND=memory vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && playwright test
scripts.ci:quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test -- --coverage && npm run ai:eval && npm run build && npm run perf:budget && npm run build:functions
